solutions.title: Build columns
solutions.strategy: Construct every column string and compare it with the corresponding row string.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every character is copied into a column.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Column strings can store all characters.

solutions.title: Direct symmetry check
solutions.strategy: For each row character, directly verify the mirrored column position exists and matches.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each existing character is checked once.
